docs.summary: OverflowList component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use OverflowList to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing.
OverflowList works well for arranging related content and creating responsive layouts. Use it to maintain visual consistency throughout your application.

anatomy.description: OverflowList is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistent spacing
bestPractices.description: Use uniform gaps and padding with overflow-list.

bestPractices.title: Don't vary spacing
bestPractices.description: Avoid inconsistent gaps that create visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Consider responsive behavior
bestPractices.description: Ensure overflow-list adapts to different screen sizes.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore breakpoints
bestPractices.description: Fixed layouts can break on different devices.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest deeply
bestPractices.description: Avoid excessive nesting that complicates layout.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Maximum number of items to show before overflow

props.name: renderOverflow
props.description: Render function for the overflow trigger

props.name: renderOverflowItem
props.description: Render function for items in the overflow popover

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.
